rules.requirement: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.

assertingTests.name: the Sailor makes the chosen recipient drunk until dusk and supports choosing themself (BMR-SAILOR-01, BMR-SAILOR-02)
a sober Sailor survives execution and only a bypassing kill lands (BMR-SAILOR-01)
the Sailor's choice makes one player drunk until dusk and the next choice ends it (BMR-SAILOR-01, BMR-SAILOR-02)
a healthy Sailor makes the host's choice drunk until dusk (BMR-SAILOR-01, BMR-SAILOR-02)
a poisoned Sailor or Innkeeper gives no effect and still ends the last choice (BMR-SAILOR-01, BMR-INNKEEPER-01)
the Sailor cannot die while healthy but dies while poisoned or drunk
BMR target restrictions reject dead, self and evil targets (BMR-CHAMBERMAID-03)

rules.requirement: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.

assertingTests.name: a Sailor choosing the Goon completes without an effect cycle (BMR-SAILOR-02)
a Sailor or an Innkeeper who chooses the Goon is drunk and the ability fails (BMR-GOON-01, BMR-SAILOR-02, BMR-INNKEEPER-01)
